text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~ It's finally here, finally here~♪ 
Free coffee refill day!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I wonder how the coffee shop owner is 
doing? I hope it hasn't gone out of 
business for being too much of a hidden 
gem—

text_block_list.name: Lovey-Dovey Couple
text_block_list.text:
Oh nooo, it says there's another hour of 
waiting! Though time'll fly by if we're 
together~♪

text_block_list.name: Stylish Girls
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa☆ It's just like in the magazine! 
Traditional coffee shops are so retro and 
stylishly cool, aren't they~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...My sanctuary... has turned into a 
breeding ground of sparkles..."

Overcome with sorrow, they plodded away in 
retreat...
